officialSource.title: Joint declaration following the G7 Foreign Ministers Meeting in Paris on 9 and 10 November 2026
officialSource.finding: The statement recognizes opportunities and safeguards for frontier models, and notes possible misuse in malicious cyber activities and the enhancement of dangerous capabilities. It also refers to the Hiroshima AI Process.
